name: Bestiary of the Mountains and Seas
detailed_description:
Shanhaijing Bestiary" - A Matching and Purification Journey in a Fantasy World

In this mysterious universe hidden deep in the wilderness, the once-prosperous Shanhai world is being eroded by dark magic puppets. Only through your power of manipulation, by matching and fusing all things, can you awaken vitality and restore the glory of this land. This is a fantasy synthesis and cultivation game based on the "Shanhaijing", where you match spiritual beasts, purify cursed lands, and create your own magical fairy island.

Core Gameplay Highlights

▶ A Fantasy World Where Everything Can Be Matched

• Explore over 500 unique creations: From spiritual beast eggs to mythological creatures, from trees of spiritual power to mysterious treasure chests, all can be interacted with and matched.

• Innovative three-in-one evolution mechanism: Freely drag objects in beautiful scenes, and combine three of the same items to evolve into a higher-level form.

• Life Sphere Purification System: Release purification energy through matching to gradually dispel the dark curse on the continent.

• Goddess Statue Puzzle Challenge: Each map hides a sealed goddess statue, and high-level synthesis can remove the seal to obtain secret realm rewards.

• Spiritual Beast Breeding: Match spiritual beast eggs to hatch offspring and unlock over 120+ Shanhaijing divine beasts waiting for you to synthesize and evolve.

Embark on your Shanhai journey now!

You can purchase the Spirit Beast Pearl at the corresponding price tier directly from the inventory store or by jumping to the purchase option within the game：

Renminbi（￥）: 2 12 18 25 38 198 328 428 648

US Dollar（＄）： 0.3 1.5 2 3 4.99 25 45 59.99 89.99

The corresponding number of Spirit Beast Pearls that can be obtained：20 150 240 350 560 2400 3840 5000 8000

Rare items and the stamina required to enter levels can be purchased using Spirit Beast Pearls, which are a valuable in-game currency.
